data.professional_title: Senior Consultant | Senior Business Analyst | Fraud Risk & FinCrime Specialist
data.summary:
Dynamic and results-driven Business Analyst & Fraud Risk expert with 15+ years’ experience across Banking, Financial Crime Control, Identity & Access Management, Digital Products, Data Platforms & Mobile Apps. Proven record leading business analysis, fraud prevention, solution delivery, migration programs, UAT, stakeholder management & Agile execution. Strong ability to translate business needs into actionable user stories, optimize processes, and deliver value across cross-functional teams.
Core strengths include Gap Analysis, BRD/FRD/User Stories, Payments Messaging, SWIFT, ISO 20022, AML, Financial Crime operations, Data Migration, Fraud Detection, Process Transformation, CI/CD support, UAT, and Agile leadership.

CORE COMPETENCIES & Skills
Business Analysis & Documentation -Requirements Elicitation, BRD/FRD, Wireframes, Acceptance Criteria
BRD/FRD/User Stories, Process Mapping (AS-IS/TO-BE), GAP Analysis, RTM
Agile/Scrum Delivery - Agile Scrum, Story Grooming, Sprint Planning & UAT
Data Analysis, SQL Basics, CI/CD Collaboration, Fraud & Risk Controls
Stakeholder & Client Management, SPOC for Dev/QA/NFT teams
Test Strategy, UAT & Defect Triage
Product Backlog Management & Prioritization
Dashboard & Reporting (Smartsheet’s, Excel, Jira)
Data & Fraud Intelligence, UAT & Test Governance, Stakeholder & Client Management
Process Optimization, AML/KYC & Financial Crime Controls, Regulatory Compliance Awareness
TOOLS & PLATFORMS
JIRA | Confluence | AHA | SAS | Salesforce | Postman | DevOps | GitHub | Lucidchart | Visio | MS Office | Smartsheets

experience.company:

responsibilities: Led AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis to improve data delivery standards
Supported real-time transaction data delivery (<1-sec SLA) for Financial Crime systems
Conducted triage & fix planning; ensured story readiness & delivery value
Led requirement discovery & documentation for Mobile UX revamp
Managed resource planning, cost forecasting & budget control
Built dashboards; streamlined vendor utilization & reporting
Led BA functions: UML Diagrams, Mockups, Feature backlog, UAT
Conducted quality audits, coaching & operational governance
Supported BA & Ops for process improvements & compliance updates
Performed quality audit on New developed application RISKFORT which performs KYC/AML reviews & customer profiling to prevent Financial Crime.
Managed fraud cases, background validations & financial crime assessments on SAS (Transaction monitoring application).

Led fraud defense operations across AML, CDD, scam detection, KYC, and risk controls, And Development of Transaction Monitoring Application contributing to safe banking, reducing fraud losses, and ensuring superior customer service.
Led migration from Falcon to SAS –  Led Falcon → SAS migration for fraud intelligence uplift
Created enterprise RTM framework improving traceability, QA control and Defect management
